messages:
maria: Quick readiness check for onboarding orion-9b — conversion CI ran overnight. Artifacts almost ready but want a quick pass on tokenizer + dtype choices before we push to the catalog. Anyone available?
aj: where are the raw weights? I can run the fp16 conversion locally if you point me.
maria: weights are at s3://redwood-ingest/onboard/orion-9b/raw/weights.tar.gz sha256: 3a7e9f8c2dbe9f4a6a1f2b0c9d4e8f1b6c2a9d4e5f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7
convert-bot: CI: conversion-job-186789 - started
convert-bot: CI: conversion-job-186789 - finished (partial) — artifacts pushed to s3://redwood-models/onboard/orion-9b/v1/
convert-bot: Artifacts: model_shard_00_of_08.safetensors, model_shard_01_of_08.safetensors, ..., tokenizer.model, model_config.json, conversion_meta.json
sam: heads-up: tokenizer.model is sentencepiece. QA found decode noise for short prompts — looks like BOS token isn't present in tokenizer.json (we expect <s> as bos).
maria: hmm I only saw tokenizer.model uploaded (binary) — did the conversion script regenerate tokenizer.json? I thought we relied on tokenizer files from the repo.
lena: repo tokenizers live at github.com/redwood-inference/tokenizers/orion-9b — tokenizer.json is missing there, only tokenizer.model. We should add tokenizer.json with special tokens for the serving runtimes.
aj: easy fix: create tokenizer.json with entries {"bos_token":"<s>","eos_token":"</s>","unk_token":"<unk>","pad_token":"<pad>"} and upload alongside tokenizer.model. sam: also confirm piece id mapping — some older spm configs have unk id != 0 which breaks our padding logic.
maria: I'll run a quick script to normalize. snippet: ```python3 scripts/make_tokenizer_json.py --sp-model s3://redwood-models/onboard/orion-9b/v1/tokenizer.model --out tokenizer.json --bos "<s>" --eos "</s>"```
kevin: dtype question — training was in bf16. For serving we prefer fp16 on the current GPU pool. Any blockers to casting to fp16? FP16 sometimes causes nan on one of the attention ops for this arch.
maria: flagged that — conversion step includes a bf16->fp16 pass. We ran a quick torch.jit sanity and saw one NaN on step 0 with fp16 in CI (attention softmax). We're isolating whether it's a kernel bug or numeric underflow. If we can't fix quickly we'll keep bf16 for dedicated and add fp16 fallback that routes to a compatible runtime.
aj: suggestion: do TP-aware casting: keep kv/cache in bf16, weights in fp16. That reduces NaN exposure. Also ensure the config field "tensor_parallel": 2 is present in model_config.json so the runtime picks the right layout.
maria: current conversion command used: ```bash
python convert_weights.py --input s3://redwood-ingest/onboard/orion-9b/raw/weights.tar.gz \
  --out s3://redwood-models/onboard/orion-9b/v1/ --format safetensors --dtype fp16 --tp 2 --shards 8
```
convert-bot: conversion meta: {"tp_size":"2","shards":"8","dtype":"fp16","converted_by":"maria","job":"186789"} (stored in conversion_meta.json)
lena: model_config.json: CI schema validator flagged layer_norm_eps mismatch (we expect 1e-5). Current file has 1e-6. Please sync.
maria: noted — will update model_config.json and re-run validator. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/4123 — added conversion script, meta, and tokenizer.json (WIP).
aj: I'll review PR 4123 tomorrow morning. Left a comment about the layernorm and one about naming of shard files (we canonicalize to shard_00_of_08.safetensors).
kevin: what's the rollback story if fp16 causes regressions in canary? We should pin a bf16 variant and add a routing policy.
maria: plan: canary rollout to Dedicated pool with tensor_parallel=2, policy: prefer fp16; if latency improves but quality drops, automatic fallback to bf16 variant (we'll upload bf16 safetensors to v1/bf16/). I've added conversion_meta flag "fallback_variant":"bf16" in the PR.
sam: tests: tokenizer decode unit test failing on CI right now — that's blocking merge. The fix is the tokenizer.json addition + ensuring unk id 0.
maria: uploaded tokenizer.json to s3 and pushed the PR update. CI triggered: https://ci.redwood.internal/186789/convert-4123
convert-bot: CI result: convert-4123 - unit tests: 23 passed, 1 failed (tokenizer decode).
maria: fixed in branch, re-run.
convert-bot: CI result: convert-4123 - all checks passed ✅
convert-bot: final artifacts (v1): s3://redwood-models/onboard/orion-9b/v1/model_shard_00_of_08.safetensors (sha256: a4d9f2...), model_config.json (sha256: b7c1e9...), tokenizer.json (sha256: c3f4a1...)
aj: quick manual review done — layer_norm_eps updated, naming consistent. leaving an approval on the PR.
maria: thanks! tagging for canary deploy. @eng-runtime please schedule canary for tomorrow 09:00 PST.
kevin: scheduled. I'll also create the bf16 fallback artifacts in v1/bf16/ just in case.
lena: I'll update the catalog entry template with the dtype/tp/shard metadata fields so product + SRE have visibility.
maria: perfect. marking this thread as ready-to-roll. Will follow up with a short postmortem if anything odd in canary. :rocket:
